notes.title: 🛠️ Lustful Victor 1.7 - Major Update Patch Notes 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’ve just dropped a huge update for Lustful Victor, focused on controller support, Steam Deck optimization, bug fixes, performance, and pure fun. Here’s what’s new:

🎮 Full Controller Support + Steam Deck Optimization
The entire game now supports full controller input — gameplay, menus, dialogues, and even the pause screen.

Built using Unity’s new input system, supporting all major controllers out of the box.

Specifically optimized for Steam Deck — plug in or pick up and play, no setup needed.

🔧 Tons of Bug Fixes
We’ve crushed a mountain of bugs across the board.

From combat glitches to UI quirks — smoother gameplay from start to finish.

🖥️ Dynamic Screen Scaling
New adaptive scaling system makes the game look great on any screen size — ultrawide, standard, or handheld.

💰 More Rewarding Combat
Enemies now drop more gold.

Looting and progression are now more immediate and satisfying.

⚔️ Faster, More Fun Gameplay Loop
We've rebalanced the game to be faster to reward and more focused on immediate fun.

Tons of subtle reworks that reduce grind and boost enjoyment.

🚀 General Improvements
Overall feel of the game is more fluid.

Countless tweaks and QoL improvements that you’ll notice even if you don’t realize it.

Thanks for sticking with Lustful Victor!
We’re working hard on our next game, which is coming very soon — and trust us, it’s something you won’t want to miss.
Join our Discord to get early looks, dev updates, and hang out with the community!

Oh — and the official Lustful Victor soundtrack is dropping soon too. Stay tuned. 💋

— NeonByteStudio

notes.title: Lustful Victor – Version 1.5
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay & Controls[/b]

Dash is now X-axis only – vertical dash is gone for better control and predictability.

W key now also triggers jump – an alternative control option for comfort.

New interaction system – dialogue interactions (outside of shops and quests) are now more intuitive and compatible with most keys, not just locked to E.

[b]Display & UI[/b]

Windowed screen size is now adjustable in-game – no need to mess with external configs.

Improved fullscreen behavior – native handling to better preserve UI scaling and automatically detect optimal resolution.

Chinese font support improved – better rendering and readability for Chinese characters + Fix Chinese display.

[b]Balance & Polish[/b]

More balanced gameplay – multiple tweaks for a smoother and fairer experience across the board.

[b]Fixes & Optimization[/b]

Massive optimization pass – cleaner code, smoother performance, reduced load.

Tons of micro bug fixes – seriously, a lot. Small stuff all over the place, cleaned up.

notes.title: Lustful Victor 1.4 - Changelog :
notes.content:
New Features:

Essential Tutorial Added: A full tutorial has been integrated to improve accessibility.
Boss 3 Improved: Added a new animation for Boss 3 and a missing sound effect.

Improvements:

Optimized Input Storage: A more efficient and faster method for storing user inputs has been implemented.

Bug Fixes:

Text Display Issue Fixed: Resolved a bug that displayed %Text% before the actual dialogue.
Pause Menu Input Fix: Fixed an issue where in-game inputs were still being registered while in the pause menu.
Input Mix Bug Fixed: Resolved an issue where input mix during the pause menu caused controllers to stop functioning.
Shop Button Bug Fixed: Fixed a bug that prevented a button in the shop from working properly.
Layer Issue: Fixed a bug that caused a layer to overlap another.

notes.title: Lustful Victor Changelog 1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug that could cause the player to get stuck in the ground.

notes.title: Changelog Lustful Victor 1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Base damage increased from 20 to 40 (x2).

[*] Added mouse support for shooting in addition to "X".

[*] Movement is much more responsive – the shooting threshold window has been adjusted from 0.1f to 3.9f, allowing near-instant shooting when releasing the run key.

[*] Added lighting in the intro.

[*] Further increased font sizes where adjustments were previously insufficient.
[/list]

notes.title: Lustful Victor 1.1 Changelog
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Simplified Shooting: Now you can shoot using only the shoot key—no need to aim first. Just press shoot and fire away.

[*] Enhanced Readability: Larger fonts have been implemented for a clearer display.

[*] Controller Support: Partial controller support added. Controllers work flawlessly during gameplay, though menu navigation may still not work.
[/list]

Descending to Petaputua, a sprawling, neon-lit metropolis, she finds a city drenched in decadence and danger. Here, technology and humanity intertwine in ways both thrilling and forbidden.

Petaputua’s streets are rife with vice and violence. Cybernetic thugs, seductive rogue AIs, and ruthless corporate enforcers dominate the city's underbelly. Each encounter pushes Noëlle to her limits, testing her skills and her resolve.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d038a0f46ca408623df576f0ae217f08e690f1e0.png[/img]

In this city of sin, power comes at a price. Noëlle must navigate a world of corrupt deals and illicit pleasures to gain the upper hand. Grinding for experience and gold is essential, with rewards that go beyond mere survival—upgrading equipment, learning new, provocative skills, and indulging in the city's dark temptations.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/71e33f42f7c2853f8fec612b7d299d4b8d885207.png[/img]

Victor, the enigmatic antagonist, manipulates the chaos from the shadows. His true motives remain hidden, but his influence pervades every corner of Petaputua, driving Noëlle towards a confrontation that promises to be as intimate as it is deadly.
